mcqs.question: Under the Ministry of Home Affairs guidelines on “Vande Mataram” at official functions and educational institutions, which of the following is correct?
options: All six stanzas are sung for 3 minutes 10 seconds, with people standing attentively.
All six stanzas are sung for 3 minutes 10 seconds, with people remaining seated.
Only selected stanzas are sung for 3 minutes 10 seconds, with people standing attentively.
All six stanzas are sung for 10 minutes, with people standing attentively.
mcqs.explanation: The guidelines require all six stanzas of “Vande Mataram” to be sung for 3 minutes 10 seconds, while everyone stands attentively. The most tempting alternative is the second option, but the guidelines require standing attentively, not remaining seated.

mcqs.question: The February 2026 guidelines on “Vande Mataram” marked which historical milestone?
options: 150 years since its first publication on 7 November 1875.
The centenary of its first publication on 7 November 1875.
150 years since its first publication in February.
150 years since its first publication on 7 November in a later year.
mcqs.explanation: The guidelines marked 150 years since the first publication of “Vande Mataram” on 7 November 1875. The second option is the closest trap, but the milestone was 150 years, not the centenary.
